greeting: The path brings us together. For now.
You walk with purpose. Rare, these days.
The Uplands whisper secrets. I listen.
The coat has seen many roads. As have I.
dialog.shop_open: I carry small things. Useful things. Traded from road to road.
dialog.shop_prompt: Travel goods. Maps. Rumors. Silence, if you prefer.
haggle: Value is where you find it.
The road teaches: nothing is free, but much is cheap.
For a fellow walker? Consider it a gift.
purchase_fail: The road will bring you back.
rumor: The black coat watches. Has always watched. Will always watch.
The twins complete each other. Separate them, and both fade.
Hashimoto guards more than stone. He guards memory.
I walked through Dustbelt once. The barrels... they remember too.
dialog.quest_hook: Lost my walking stick at the Moon Viewpoint. Ancient wood. Gift from a sage. Retrieve it, and I'll share what I know of the secret paths.
dialog.quest_active: The Moon Viewpoint. Eastern overlook. Staff of oak, carved with moons.
dialog.quest_complete: My staff. Thank you. Here - a map of the hidden ways. Known only to wanderers.
dialog.quest_reward: Wanderer's Path Map - Secret routes revealed
farewell: The path rises to meet you.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning mist. Best time for walking.
dialog.time_noon: Sun high. Rest in shade. Walk in shadow.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening light. The golden hour of travelers.
dialog.time_night: Night walking. Stars as guides. Moon as companion.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The staff-finder. A fellow traveler, truly.
dialog.wisdom: Every step away is also a step toward. The path is a circle.

party_reactions.kade: Why do I feel like they know more than they're saying?
party_reactions.twist: Where are you walking TO? ...Nowhere? Just walking? Wow!
party_reactions.korr: The stillness in motion. I understand.
party_reactions.renna: Classic mysterious stranger. Bet they have a tragic backstory.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New face. New story. I'm listening.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: We meet again. The path is smaller than it seems.
relationship_dialog.friend: Reliable companion on the road of life.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Walk with me awhile. I have much to share.

mini_quest.title: The Pilgrim's Staff
mini_quest.description: Retrieve Walker's ancient walking stick from Moon Viewpoint
